title: Lapsed-Order Refund Amount — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty
content:
**Lapsed-order refund — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty.** The lapsed-order refund on an ordered set the store cancels because its hold period lapsed is the tire price paid less the restocking fee and the storage charge, rounded half up to the cent, and goes back to the tender that paid the ticket.

1. **Tire price paid** — the tire count times the price per tire, less the line's set instant savings when the tire count is at least the line's tires-needed figure, less the fleet discount taken on the tires invoice posted for the vehicle on the purchase date when the ticket was charged to a fleet account. The ticket of such a set carries the tire price paid alone, because the mounting, the valve-stem or TPMS-kit charge and the disposal fee are rung when the tires are mounted. The fleet discount on a tires invoice is one percentage taken on every discountable line of the ticket, the tire price, the mounting and the valve-stem or TPMS-kit lines alike; wherever the tire price paid takes it off, the whole discount amount of that invoice is counted against the tire price, the part taken on the mounting and kit lines included, because those lines are never figured below the line's own charges here.
2. **Restocking fee** — the line's restocking percentage of the tire price paid.
3. **Days past hold** — the calendar days from the purchase date plus the line's hold after purchase, to today.
4. **Storage charge** — $2.00 times the tire count for every whole week past hold.

No intermediate figure is rounded; the refund is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

**Worked (hypothetical order):** 4 tires at $110.00 on a line with $60.00 set savings and a 10% restocking fee, paid by card, 15 days past hold — tire price paid $380.00; restocking fee $38.00; storage 2 whole weeks, $16.00; refund $326.00.
